exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
outcome: Safety of PPIUCD (menstrual irregularities, vaginal discharge, pelvic infection, perforation, failure, expulsion, removal)
cohort: A total of 120 patients who underwent PPIUCD insertions after either vaginal or caesarean deliveries were included.
finding: PPIUCD is an effective intervention in both caesarean and vaginal deliveries with no significant differences in most safety measures, although missing string incidence was significantly higher in the caesarean group.
mod_finding: PPIUCD insertion in both vaginal and caesarean deliveries showed no significant differences in safety measures such as menstrual complaints, fever, and vaginal discharge, but missing string incidence was significantly higher in the caesarean group (60%) compared to the vaginal group (16.66%).
